summary: E2E test of NEW agency onboarding wizard + per-profile plan selection + bulk Finish&Pay + regression. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests pass (fresh onboarded flag, POST /agency/profile save, PUT /agency/profiles/{id}/plan set+clear+persistence, invalid plan rejected, ownership isolation, bulk checkout sums €105 for Sofia 4w+VIP+Valentina 2w, bulk requires >=1 plan, agency plan pricing €30/€50). Frontend: fresh register → agency-wizard-steps visible → 3 steps (Basic info / Services with apply-services-to-all / Rates & availability) → Finish lands on empty roster with new agency name. Onboarded login (agency@test.com) skips wizard, shows 'Elite Agency Demo' header, Total=3, Sofia/Valentina/Amara rows. plan-select-<providerId> dropdown has exactly 'No plan / Featured · 2 weeks · €30 / Featured · 4 weeks · €50'. Selecting a plan reveals vip-toggle-<providerId>. Persistence verified via reload. finish-pay-bar summed correctly: pre-Amara=€105 (Sofia 4w+VIP=75 + Valentina 2w=30), post-Amara set to 2w=€135. Clicking finish-pay-btn redirected successfully to checkout.stripe.com. Add-profile → /dashboard/profile/new opens 4-step wizard (Basic Info / Photos & Video's / Services / Rates & Availability) — NO 'Activate' step for agency, city/country prefilled from agency defaults. Edit → /dashboard/profile/<id> renders scoped ProviderDashboard, back-to-agency-btn returns to /dashboard. Independent regression (provider1@lumiere.com): lands on single-profile ProviderDashboard 'Welcome, Sophia', no plan-select / no finish-pay-bar / no add-profile-btn / no agency header.

issues: React hydration warning caused by external instrumentation wrapping <option> in a <span x-excluded>. Warning only, not a functional bug (form works). Same class of noise as iteration_7.

server.py get_agency_profile still spreads full mongo doc after `{_id:0}` projection — safe, but consider returning a Pydantic response model for stability.
checkout-bulk endpoint validates presence of pending plans and re-derives amounts server-side from PLANS map (good — client cannot manipulate totals).
